args.request: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.

story.title: Night City Montage
story.setting: A modern city at night after rain, glowing neon colours of pink, cyan and purple, cinematic look, deep shadows.

beats.text: Close shot of glowing neon signs buzzing and flickering on a building wall, slow camera drift.
Wide shot of a lit commuter train passing fast across an elevated track, motion blur of its windows.
Low shot of a wet street with neon colours reflecting in puddles, ripples spreading as drops fall.

story.music: Original upbeat electronic track, driving synth bass, crisp drums, bright arpeggios, about 120 BPM, instrumental with no vocals.
